title: Find - Array
content:
Member of: All Arrays Locates a particular value inside an array and returns the index Syntax: int Function Find(;/element type/; akElement, int aiStartIndex = 0) native Parameters: - akElement: The element to locate - aiStartIndex: Where to start the search Default: 0 Return Value: The index of the item in the array, or a negative value if it was not found. Examples: if (MyIntArray.Find(1) < 0) Debug.Trace("Did not find 1 in the array") endIf
int firstPosition = MyStringArray.Find("Hello") Debug.Trace("Found Hello at position " + firstPosition) int secondPosition = MyStringArray.Find("Hello", firstPosition + 1) Debug.Trace("Found a second Hello at position " + secondPosition) See Also: - RFind - Array - FindStruct - Array - RFindStruct - Array
